answer.text: Only Jake Morrison averaged above the 15% cap on Safety Equipment since April 2026, at 23.06%. The other 19 reps averaged between 2.69% and 3.53%. These are average discounts per rep, so other reps may have given individual lines above 15% that this view doesn't show.
assumptions: Compared each rep's average discount on Safety Equipment sales lines to the 15% cap you gave
The 15% cap is taken from your question, not checked against policy documents

sql.sql:
select r.rep_name as sales_rep, round(avg(s.discount_pct) filter (where s.line_type = 'sale'), 2) as avg_discount_pct
from marts.fct_sales as s
inner join marts.dim_sales_rep as r on r.sales_rep_key = s.sales_rep_key
inner join marts.dim_product as p on p.product_key = s.product_key
where s.order_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s and p.category = any(%(filter_0)s)
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s
